title: Escalation must re-arrange after a refused provider, not retry its siblings
goal: A funded mission escalated from deepinfra-qwen-coder to claude-sonnet (no_credit), then to claude-opus (same provider, already recorded no_credit) and to claude-sonnet again: three of four attempts burned on a provider the ledger already knew was unfunded. The ladder is built once per task, so cooling and no-credit records never reach the later attempts. Each attempt after a provider-class failure must re-arrange the ladder from the ledger (cooling providers excluded, a refused model's provider demoted) so an attempt is never spent on a provider the harness already knows cannot serve, and the failure record names which model was refused.
